content.en: Industries in the **Indian Economy** are classified using various parameters to facilitate policy formulation and economic planning. Key criteria include **Raw Materials** (agro-based, mineral-based), **Size** (Micro, Small, Medium, Large), **Ownership** (Public, Private, Joint, Cooperative), and **Nature of Output** (Basic, Capital, Consumer goods).
